objects.constraint public.event_types.event_type:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (payment IS NULL) THEN true
    WHEN ((jsonb_typeof(payment) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((payment -> 'prices'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((payment -> 'currency'::text)) = 'string'::text)) THEN ((owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (scheduling_type = 'individual'::text) AND (booking_mode = 'individual'::text) AND (NOT allow_guests) AND (recurrence IS NULL) AND ((payment - ARRAY['currency'::text, 'prices'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((payment ->> 'currency'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['usd'::text, 'eur'::text, 'gbp'::text, 'cad'::text, 'aud'::text, 'jpy'::text])) AND (jsonb_array_length((payment -> 'prices'::text)) = cardinality(allowed_durations_minutes)) AND (jsonb_path_query_array(payment, '$."prices"[*]."durationMinutes"'::jsonpath) = to_jsonb(allowed_durations_minutes)) AND (NOT jsonb_path_exists(payment, '$."prices"[*]?(((((@.type() != "object" || !(exists (@."amountMinor"))) || @."amountMinor".type() != "number") || @."amountMinor" != @."amountMinor".floor()) || @."amountMinor" < $"minimum") || @."amountMinor" > 99999999)'::jsonpath, jsonb_build_object('minimum',
    CASE
        WHEN ((payment ->> 'currency'::text) = 'gbp'::text) THEN 30
        ELSE 50
    END))))
    ELSE false
END)
